title: Supplementary materials for: Generative AI Copilots in Chemical, Process, and Manufacturing Engineering: A Structured Review of Validation Practices and the Case for Shared, Domain-Specific Benchmarks
description: Corpus (158 records), screening criteria, search logs, pipeline source code and reference-verification scripts accompanying a structured (SALSA) review of generative-AI copilots in chemical, process and manufacturing engineering. Abstracts and full texts are not redistributed; records are identified by DOI.
